005package org.wpilib.math.kinematics;
006
007import static org.wpilib.units.Units.Meters;
008
009import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Pose2d;
010import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Pose3d;
011import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Rotation2d;
012import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Rotation3d;
013import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Translation2d;
014import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Translation3d;
015import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Twist3d;
016import org.wpilib.units.measure.Distance;
017import org.wpilib.util.UsageReporting;
018
019/**
020 * Class for double follower wheel odometry. Odometry allows you to track the robot's position on
021 * the field over the course of a match using readings from 2 encoders and a gyroscope.
022 *
023 * <p>This class is meant to be an easy replacement for {@link TwoDeadWheelOdometry}, only requiring
024 * the addition of appropriate conversions between 2D and 3D versions of geometry classes. (See
025 * {@link Pose3d#Pose3d(Pose2d)}, {@link Rotation3d#Rotation3d(Rotation2d)}, {@link
026 * Translation3d#Translation3d(Translation2d)}, and {@link Pose3d#toPose2d()}.)
027 *
028 * <p>Teams can use odometry during the autonomous period for complex tasks like path following.
029 * Furthermore, odometry can be used for latency compensation when using computer-vision systems.
030 */
031public class TwoDeadWheelOdometry3d {
032  /*
033   * This class uses logic cloned from Odometry3d.java. It does not extend Odometry3d because the
034   * structure of the kinematics and odometry classes assume that the gyro angle is independent from
035   * the kinematics, while in a two-dead-wheel configuration, the gyro is required to do the
036   * kinematics, as otherwise the forward kinematics is rank-deficient.
037   */
038
039  private final double m_xWheelYPos;
040  private final double m_yWheelXPos;
041
042  private Pose3d m_pose;
043
044  private Rotation3d m_previousGyroAngle;
045
046  private double m_previousXWheelPos;
047  private double m_previousYWheelPos;
048
049  /**
050   * Constructs a TwoDeadWheelOdometry object.
051   *
052   * @param xWheelYPos The y-position of the forward-facing wheel relative to the center of the
053   *     robot in meters.
054   * @param yWheelXPos The x-position of the left-facing wheel relative to the center of the robot
055   *     in meters.
056   * @param xWheelPos The distance traveled by the forward-facing wheel, in meters.
057   * @param yWheelPos The distance traveled by the left-facing wheel, in meters.
058   * @param gyroAngle The angle reported by the gyroscope. This does not need to be offset to match
059   *     the robot's orientation on the field.
060   * @param initialPose The starting position of the robot on the field.
061   */
062  public TwoDeadWheelOdometry3d(
063      double xWheelYPos,
064      double yWheelXPos,
065      double xWheelPos,
066      double yWheelPos,
067      Rotation3d gyroAngle,
068      Pose3d initialPose) {
069    m_xWheelYPos = xWheelYPos;
070    m_yWheelXPos = yWheelXPos;
071    m_previousGyroAngle = gyroAngle;
072    m_previousXWheelPos = xWheelPos;
073    m_previousYWheelPos = yWheelPos;
074    m_pose = initialPose;
075
076    UsageReporting.reportUsage("TwoDeadWheelOdometry3d", "");
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Constructs a TwoDeadWheelOdometry object with the default pose at the origin.
081   *
082   * @param xWheelYPos The y-position of the forward-facing wheel relative to the center of the
083   *     robot in meters.
084   * @param yWheelXPos The x-position of the left-facing wheel relative to the center of the robot
085   *     in meters.
086   * @param xWheelPos The distance traveled by the forward-facing wheel, in meters.
087   * @param yWheelPos The distance traveled by the left-facing wheel, in meters.
088   * @param gyroAngle The angle reported by the gyroscope. This does not need to be offset to match
089   *     the robot's orientation on the field.
090   */
091  public TwoDeadWheelOdometry3d(
092      double xWheelYPos,
093      double yWheelXPos,
094      double xWheelPos,
095      double yWheelPos,
096      Rotation3d gyroAngle) {
097    this(xWheelYPos, yWheelXPos, xWheelPos, yWheelPos, gyroAngle, Pose3d.ZERO);
098  }
099
100  /**
101   * Constructs a TwoDeadWheelOdometry object.
102   *
103   * @param xWheelYPos The y-position of the forward-facing wheel relative to the center of the
104   *     robot in meters.
105   * @param yWheelXPos The x-position of the left-facing wheel relative to the center of the robot
106   *     in meters.
107   * @param xWheelPos The distance traveled by the forward-facing wheel, in meters.
108   * @param yWheelPos The distance traveled by the left-facing wheel, in meters.
109   * @param gyroAngle The angle reported by the gyroscope. This does not need to be offset to match
110   *     the robot's orientation on the field.
111   * @param initialPose The starting position of the robot on the field.
112   */
113  public TwoDeadWheelOdometry3d(
114      Distance xWheelYPos,
115      Distance yWheelXPos,
116      Distance xWheelPos,
117      Distance yWheelPos,
118      Rotation3d gyroAngle,
119      Pose3d initialPose) {
120    this(
121        xWheelYPos.in(Meters),
122        yWheelXPos.in(Meters),
123        xWheelPos.in(Meters),
124        yWheelPos.in(Meters),
125        gyroAngle,
126        initialPose);
127  }
128
129  /**
130   * Constructs a TwoDeadWheelOdometry object with the default pose at the origin.
131   *
132   * @param xWheelYPos The y-position of the forward-facing wheel relative to the center of the
133   *     robot in meters.
134   * @param yWheelXPos The x-position of the left-facing wheel relative to the center of the robot
135   *     in meters.
136   * @param xWheelPos The distance traveled by the forward-facing wheel, in meters.
137   * @param yWheelPos The distance traveled by the left-facing wheel, in meters.
138   * @param gyroAngle The angle reported by the gyroscope. This does not need to be offset to match
139   *     the robot's orientation on the field.
140   */
141  public TwoDeadWheelOdometry3d(
142      Distance xWheelYPos,
143      Distance yWheelXPos,
144      Distance xWheelPos,
145      Distance yWheelPos,
146      Rotation3d gyroAngle) {
147    this(xWheelYPos, yWheelXPos, xWheelPos, yWheelPos, gyroAngle, Pose3d.ZERO);
148  }
149
150  /**
151   * Resets the robot's position on the field.
152   *
153   * <p>The gyroscope angle does not need to be reset here in the user's robot code.
154   *
155   * @param xWheelPos The distance traveled by the forward-facing wheel, in meters.
156   * @param yWheelPos The distance traveled by the left-facing wheel, in meters.
157   * @param gyroAngle The angle reported by the gyroscope. This does not need to be offset to match
158   *     the robot's orientation on the field.
159   * @param pose The new position of the robot on the field.
160   */
161  public void resetPosition(double xWheelPos, double yWheelPos, Rotation3d gyroAngle, Pose3d pose) {
162    m_previousGyroAngle = gyroAngle;
163    m_previousXWheelPos = xWheelPos;
164    m_previousYWheelPos = yWheelPos;
165    m_pose = pose;
166  }
167
168  /**
169   * Resets the pose.
170   *
171   * @param pose The pose to reset to.
172   */
173  public void resetPose(Pose3d pose) {
174    m_pose = pose;
175  }
176
177  /**
178   * Resets the translation of the pose.
179   *
180   * @param translation The translation to reset to.
181   */
182  public void resetTranslation(Translation3d translation) {
183    m_pose = new Pose3d(translation, m_pose.getRotation());
184  }
185
186  /**
187   * Resets the rotation of the pose.
188   *
189   * @param rotation The rotation to reset to.
190   */
191  public void resetRotation(Rotation3d rotation) {
192    m_pose = new Pose3d(m_pose.getTranslation(), rotation);
193  }
194
195  /**
196   * Returns the position of the robot on the field.
197   *
198   * @return The pose of the robot (x, y, and z are in meters).
199   */
200  public Pose3d getPose() {
201    return m_pose;
202  }
203
204  /**
205   * Updates the robot's position.
206   *
207   * @param xWheelPos The distance traveled by the forward-facing wheel, in meters.
208   * @param yWheelPos The distance traveled by the left-facing wheel, in meters.
209   * @param gyroAngle The angle reported by the gyroscope. This does not need to be offset to match
210   *     the robot's orientation on the field.
211   * @return The updated pose.
212   */
213  public Pose3d update(double xWheelPos, double yWheelPos, Rotation3d gyroAngle) {
214    var deltaAngle = gyroAngle.relativeTo(m_previousGyroAngle);
215    var angle_difference = deltaAngle.toVector();
216
217    final var deltaTheta = deltaAngle.toRotation2d().getRadians();
218    final var deltaX = xWheelPos - m_previousXWheelPos + deltaTheta * m_xWheelYPos;
219    final var deltaY = yWheelPos - m_previousYWheelPos - deltaTheta * m_yWheelXPos;
220
221    var twist =
222        new Twist3d(
223            deltaX,
224            deltaY,
225            0,
226            angle_difference.get(0),
227            angle_difference.get(1),
228            angle_difference.get(2));
229
230    m_pose = m_pose.plus(twist.exp());
231
232    m_previousGyroAngle = gyroAngle;
233    m_previousXWheelPos = xWheelPos;
234    m_previousYWheelPos = yWheelPos;
235
236    return m_pose;
237  }
238
239  /**
240   * Converts measured wheel velocities to chassis velocities using inverse kinematics.
241   *
242   * @param vx The velocity of the forward-facing wheel, in meters per second.
243   * @param vy The velocity of the sideways-facing wheel, in meters per second.
244   * @param omega The angular velocity of the robot as reported by the gyro, in radians per second.
245   * @return The velocity of the chassis.
246   */
247  public ChassisVelocities toChassisVelocities(double vx, double vy, double omega) {
248    return new ChassisVelocities(vx + omega * m_xWheelYPos, vy - omega * m_yWheelXPos, omega);
249  }
250}
